answers.question: How many weeks did it take me to watch all the Marvel Cinematic Universe movies and the main Star Wars films?
lines: [2023-05-25] User: I watched all the MCU movies, all 22 of them. I did it in about two weeks, it was a lot but worth it.

[2023-05-25] User: I'm trying to keep track of all the movies I've watched recently. Can you help me organize them in a list or something? By the way, I just finished a Star Wars marathon, watched all the main films in a week and a half, it was a wild ride!
